_note: Per-view render budgets for the GT 730M dev laptop, Compatibility renderer, 1600x900 (STYLE.md §Budgets, P1-1). Checked by `node autobuild/render_stats.mjs`; keys are RENDER_STATS fields, a view over any of them is listed. `gate` (P3-6): views whose draw calls and triangles the full verify.mjs checks windowed, each limit the value measured at P3-6 (3v3 default, bots) plus about 10 %. Timings are never gated (laptop noise). Frame times only count from a windowed run on the real GPU.
